title: engage-codex synthesis output (comparison table, NOT merger)
description: Synthesis output for engage-codex. The output is a comparison table across paths — narrative paradigms are structurally distinct and cannot be coherently combined, so merger is rejected at the schema level. Unlike engage-forge, there is no operational-graft escape hatch: narrative paradigms are not commensurable along a single structural axis, so cross-paradigm transplants destroy the paradigms' internal rhythms.

outputType.description: Must literally be the string 'comparison-table'. Any other outputType — including 'merged-outline', 'merged-artefact', 'hybrid', 'fused-artefact' — fails validation with the engage-codex synthesis-is-comparison-not-merger diagnostic.

bestServedStoryShape.description: Which kind of story this paradigm + artefact serves best (e.g., 'feature thrillers with a passive-becoming-active protagonist', 'literary short stories with a re-framing twist').

recommendedPath.description: Optional. The path number recommended for the user. Null when no clear winner emerges; the user is asked to pick before reading the critique pass findings.
